title: Add release provenance panel
purpose: Expose release provenance and artifact hashes in the operator console without making TUI a release authority.
scope: Render release provenance schema, source commit, branch, toolchain and generated artifact paths.
Render dependency inventory, SBOM, update metadata and provenance signature hashes.
Render TUI replay, ecosystem replay, functional replay and QEMU smoke artifact hashes.
Show dirty worktree or missing provenance as a promotion warning.
Keep release artifact generation in scripts/build-release.ps1.
acceptance_criteria: Release provenance panel projects existing release artifacts only.
Missing or failed provenance is shown as a blocker.
Hashes and paths are deterministic and redacted.
TUI cannot mark a release as signed or promoted by itself.
failure_modes: TUI generates or mutates release provenance.
Unsigned candidate is displayed as production signed.
